headline: OpenAI Says AI Agents Now Drive Most EU Enterprise Output
dek: An OpenAI report says Codex and ChatGPT Work generate over half of business customers' output tokens in Europe.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Agents pass the halfway mark
body: OpenAI says agentic tools now account for more than half of output tokens from ChatGPT Enterprise customers in the EU (OpenAI, TechRadar).
According to TechRadar, that is 55% agentic use versus 45% basic chatbot use.

caption.hook: OpenAI says AI agents now generate 55% of output tokens from enterprise customers in the European Union.
body: According to OpenAI and TechRadar, agentic use of Codex and ChatGPT Work ranges from 22% in Slovenia to 85% in Lithuania. TechRadar cautions that the figure measures token volume, not how many companies adopted agents.

OpenAI says weekly use of these tools among EU small and medium businesses grew more than eightfold since May. Even so, the bloc's frontier firms are just 10% of the global group, versus 65% for North America, per the report.
